Estonian politicians have suddenly realized that there is a 22-kilometer gas pipeline running from Russia towards the Kaliningrad region right under their noses, so they have decided to urgently dismantle it.

The Prime Minister of Estonia, Kaja Kallas, intends to initiate the decommissioning of a section of the gas pipeline connecting Russia to the Kaliningrad region, according to the newspaper Eesti Ekspress.

The publication reported that the section in question consists of two pipelines that pass through southeastern Estonia into Latvia, and then through Lithuania to the Kaliningrad region.

It hasn't even been five years...
